1.text: Ibihanurirwa ikibaya cyo kwerekerwamo.Noneho umeze ute, ko wuriye inzu abantu bawe bose bakaba bari hejuru y'amazu?

2.text: Yewe wa murwa wuzuye urusaku n'imivurungano we, wa mudugudu wishima we!Abantu bawe bapfuye ko batishwe n'inkota, ntibagwe mu ntambara!

3.text: Abatware bawe bose bahungiye hamwe bafatanwa imiheto, n'abantu bawe aho babasanze bahungiye kure, bababohera hamwe.

4.text: Ni cyo cyatumye mvuga nti “Nimurebe hirya mwindeba ngiye kurira cyane, mwe kwirushya ngo muramara umubabaro mfitiye umukobwa w'ubwoko bwanjye unyazwe,

5.text: kuko ari umunsi wo kwiheba no kunyukanyukwa n'ubwishobere, biturutse ku Uwiteka Umwami Nyiringabo mu kibaya cyo kwerekerwamo, hariho guhombagura inkike z'amabuye n'imiborogo igera ku misozi miremire.”

6.text: Abanyelamu bambaye ibirimba, bazanye n'ingabo ziri mu magare n'izigendera ku mafarashi, kandi ab'i Kiri basohoye ingabo.

7.text: Nuko ibibaya byawe byiza cyane byuzura amagare, n'abagendera ku mafarashi bateze ingamba ku irembo.

8.text: Atwikurura i Buyuda, nawe uwo munsi wikuburira ku ntwaro zo mu nzu y'ishyamba.

9.text: Mubonye ibyuho byo mu murwa wa Dawidi ko ari byinshi, mukoranyiriza hamwe amazi yo mu kidendezi cyo hepfo,

10.text: mubara amazu yo muri Yerusalemu, amazu muyasenyera kugira ngo mukomeze inkike.

11.text: Amazi yo mu kidendezi cya kera muyafukurira iriba hagati y'inkike zombi, ariko ntimwazirikana uwari warakoze ibyo, kandi ntimwita ku uwabiremye kera cyane.

12.text: Uwo munsi Uwiteka Nyiringabo yahamagariye abantu kurira no kuboroga, no kogosha inkomborera no kwambara ibigunira,

13.text: aho kugenza batyo habaho kunezerwa no kwishima, no kubaga inka n'intama no kurya inyama no kunywa vino bati “Reka twirire, twinywere kuko ejo tuzapfa.”

14.text: Maze Uwiteka Nyiringabo yihishurira amatwi yanjye arambwira ati “Ni ukuri uku gukiranirwa ntimuzakōzwa ngo kubaveho, kugeza aho muzapfira.” Ni ko Uwiteka Umwami Nyiringabo avuze.

15.text: Uwiteka Umwami Nyiringabo aravuga ati “Genda usange uwo munyabintu Shebuna, ari we munyanzu umubaze uti

16.text: ‘Urakora iki hano? Kandi uri kumwe na nde utuma wicukurira imva hano, ko wicukurira imva ahantu ho hejuru, ukībariza ubuturo mu rutare?

17.text: Dore Uwiteka azakujugunyisha imbaraga, nk'umunyamaboko, ni koko azakujigitira,

18.text: akuzingazinge akujugunye nk'umupira mu gihugu kigari. Aho ni ho uzagwa kandi ni ho amagare yawe y'icyubahiro azaba, wa rukozasoni rw'inzu ya shobuja we.

19.text: Nzakunyaga ubutware bwawe, kandi nzakumanura ngukure mu bukuru bwawe.’

20.text: “Uwo munsi nzahamagara umugaragu wanjye Eliyakimu, mwene Hilikiya,

21.text: mwambike umwambaro wawe mukenyeze umushumi wawe ngo akomere, mugabire ubutware bwawe kandi azaba se w'abaturage b'i Yerusalemu n'ab'inzu ya Yuda.

22.text: Urufunguzo rw'inzu ya Dawidi nzarushyira ku rutugu rwe, ni we uzakingura ntihagire ukinga kandi ni we uzakinga ntihagire ukingura.

23.text: Nzamushimangira nk'umusumari ahantu hakomeye, azabera inzu ya se intebe y'icyubahiro.

24.text: “Maze bazamujishaho icyubahiro cy'inzu ya se cyose, urubyaro rwe na bene wabo ndetse n'ibintu bitoya byose, uhereye ku bikombe ukageza ku bicuma byose.”

25.text: Uwiteka Nyiringabo aravuga ati “Ariko uwo munsi uwo musumari washimangiwe ahantu hakomeye, uzakuka kandi uzatemwa ugwe, umutwaro wari ujishweho uzacibwa”, kuko Uwiteka abivuze.
